title: Marzipan

directions: Mix almond paste, corn syrup, marshmallow creme, and rum or almond extract together.
Gradually mix in powdered sugar until the mixture is smooth and pliable enough to mold.
Divide into sections and color with food coloring based on desired fruit shapes.
Shape into fruits such as strawberries, bananas, apples, oranges, pears, grapes, pumpkins, or potatoes.
Use toothpicks to add detail lines. Roll potatoes in cocoa powder for a brown coating. Roll strawberries in red sugar for seeds.

notes: Keeps about one to two months in an airtight container.
